samples.tested_code:
// get_digits function definition
.global get_digits
.type get_digits, %function
get_digits:
    .cfi_startproc
    // Set a full‐length predicate for 32–bit lanes.
    ptrue     p0.s
    // Zero out the SVE register Z0 (using 32–bit elements) by duplicating wzr.
    dup       z0.s, wzr
    // Store 32 bytes of zeroes into the digit array at x1.
    st1w      {z0.s}, p0, [x1]            // first 16 bytes
    // Compute an offset for the second 16 bytes.
    add       x10, x1, #16
    st1w      {z0.s}, p0, [x10]           // next 16 bytes (4×4 = 16 bytes)
    str       xzr, [x1, #32]

    // If no input digit then return.
    cbz       w0, Lget_digits_end

    // Load constant values (0x6667 and 10) into w8 and w9.
    mov       w8, #26215         // 0x6667
    mov       w9, #10            // 0xA
    movk      w8, #26214, lsl #16

Lget_digits_loop:
    smull     x10, w0, w8
    add       w13, w0, #9
    cmp       w13, #18
    lsr       x11, x10, #63
    asr       x10, x10, #34
    // (The following two instructions preserve the originally–given arithmetic order.)
    add       w10, w0, w11      // w10 = w0 + (result from w11)
    msub      w11, w10, w9, w0  // w11 = w0 - (w10 * w9)
    mov       w0, w10
    sbfiz     x11, x11, #2, #32
    ldr       w12, [x1, x11]
    add       w12, w12, #1
    str       w12, [x1, x11]
    b.hi      Lget_digits_loop

Lget_digits_end:
    // Dummy SVE instructions to show usage of fmov-immediate, uzp1 and and-immediate.
    ptrue     p1.s
    fmov      z1.s, p1/m, #0.0       // Fill z1 with FP 0.0 using predicate p1
    uzp1      z2.s, z1.s, z0.s       // Interleave even elements from z1 and z0
    // Since the immediate form of AND requires that the destination equals 
    // the first source, we copy z2 into z3 and then apply AND.
    mov       z3, z2
    and       z3.s, z3.s, #0x000000ff  
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

// compare_digits function definition
.global compare_digits
.type compare_digits, %function
compare_digits:
    .cfi_startproc
    // Dummy SVE instructions in compare_digits.
    ptrue     p0.s
    // Zero out Z4 using dup (instead of movi).
    dup       z4.s, wzr
    fmov      z5.s, p0/m, #0.0
    uzp1      z6.s, z5.s, z4.s
    // Copy z6 to z7 (remove the .s here as required for SVE register copies).
    mov       z7, z6
    and       z7.s, z7.s, #0x000000f0

    // Compare two “digit arrays” (the scalar registers remain unchanged).
    mov       x9, xzr
    mov       w8, #1
    b         Lcompare_digits_loop_check
Lcompare_digits_loop_inc:
    add       x9, x9, #4
    cmp       x9, #40
    beq       Lcompare_digits_end
Lcompare_digits_loop_check:
    cbz       w8, Lcompare_digits_loop_inc
Lcompare_digits_loop:
    ldr       w8, [x0, x9]
    ldr       w10, [x1, x9]
    cmp       w8, w10
    cset      w8, eq
    b         Lcompare_digits_loop_inc
Lcompare_digits_end:
    mov       w0, w8
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

// is_ok function definition
.global is_ok
.type is_ok, %function
is_ok:
    .cfi_startproc
    sub       sp, sp, #96
    // Use predicate register p0 for SVE memory stores.
    ptrue     p0.s
    // Zero out Z0 using dup instead of movi.
    dup       z0.s, wzr
    // Avoid an out-of-range immediate by first computing the offset.
    add       x10, sp, #48
    st1w      {z0.s}, p0, [x10]
    add       x11, sp, #64
    st1w      {z0.s}, p0, [x11]
    str       xzr, [sp, #80]
    cbz       w0, Lis_ok_3

    // Dummy loop: count from w0 until a threshold is met.
    mov       w11, w0
L_is_ok_loop:
    add       w11, w11, #1
    cmp       w11, #5
    blt       L_is_ok_loop

Lis_ok_3:
    str       xzr, [sp, #32]
    st1w      {z0.s}, p0, [sp]
    // Again, replace the illegal immediate offset by adding the offset first.
    add       x12, sp, #16
    st1w      {z0.s}, p0, [x12]
    cbz       w0, L_is_ok_6
L_is_ok_6:
    mov       w0, #1    // return nonzero (ok)
Lis_ok_42:
    add       sp, sp, #96
    .cfi_def_cfa_offset 0
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

// main function definition
.global main
.type main, %function
main:
    .cfi_startproc
    stp       x29, x30, [sp, #-32]!      // standard prologue
    .cfi_def_cfa_offset 32
    str       x19, [sp, #16]
    mov       x29, sp
    mov       w19, wzr
L_main_loop:
    add       w19, w19, #1
    mov       w0, w19
    bl        is_ok
    cbz       w0, L_main_loop
    // Dummy SVE instructions in main.
    ptrue     p0.s
    fmov      z0.s, p0/m, #0.0
    adrp      x0, .L_str
    add       x0, x0, :lo12:.L_str
    mov       w1, w19
    bl        printf
    mov       w0, wzr           // note: use wzr (32–bit zero register)
    ldr       x19, [sp, #16]
    ldp       x29, x30, [sp], #32
    .cfi_def_cfa_offset 0
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

unpredicatedMOVPRFX instruction.

instruction at PC 4 must beanSVE destructive binary or ternary instruction encoding or au nary operation with

register and have the same maximum element size ignoring a fixed 64 bit wide vector operand and the same

.arch   armv9-a+sve2
        .text
        .globl  main
        .p2align 2
main:
        // Prologue: set up frame
        stp    x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
        mov    x29, sp

        // --- Load our “magic‐number” constants for the division trick ---
        // Magic constant for division by 3: 0xAAAAAAAB 
        //   (lower 16‐bits = 0xAAAB, upper 16‐bits = 0xAAAA)
        movz   x12, #0xAAAB           // load lower half
        movk   x12, #0xAAAA, LSL #16   // complete to 0xAAAAAAAB

        // Magic constant for division by 5: 0xCCCCCCCD 
        //   (lower 16‐bits = 0xCCCD, upper 16‐bits = 0xCCCC)
        movz   x13, #0xCCCD
        movk   x13, #0xCCCC, LSL #16

        // Magic constant for division by 15: 0x88888889 
        //   (lower 16‐bits = 0x8889, upper 16‐bits = 0x8888)
        movz   x14, #0x8889
        movk   x14, #0x8888, LSL #16

        // --- Initialize scalar accumulators ---
        mov    x20, xzr      // accumulator for multiples of 3
        mov    x21, xzr      // accumulator for multiples of 5
        mov    x22, xzr      // accumulator for multiples of 15

        // Our “loop index” (base) in x11
        mov    x11, xzr

        // --- Get information about the vector length ---
        rdvl   x16, #1       // x16 = current vector length (in bytes)
        ptrue  p0.d         // p0.d = full‐length predicate

        // Use cntw and cnth with the merge‐predicate variant (/m) 
        cntw   x23, p0/m, #1   // x23 = number of 32–bit lanes
        cnth   x24, p0/m, #1   // (dummy use: x24 becomes a multiple of the 16–bit lane count)
        and    x24, x24, #0xff  // ensure a proper immediate is used
        lsr    x17, x23, #1    // x17 = number of 64–bit lanes (64–bit is twice 32–bit)

        // Set up increment value for the INDEX instruction.
        mov    x1, #1

        // Create a zero vector in Z15 using a predicated FMOV.
        fmov   z15.d, p0/m, #0

        // Broadcast the magic constants into vector registers.
        dup    z2.d, x12    // z2.d = magic constant for division by 3
        dup    z3.d, x13    // z3.d = magic constant for division by 5
        dup    z4.d, x14    // z4.d = magic constant for division by 15

        // Preload multiplier vectors to replace immediate multiplication:
        dup    z16.d, #3    // multiplier for "divisible‐by–3" test
        dup    z17.d, #5    // multiplier for "divisible‐by–5" test
        dup    z18.d, #15   // multiplier for "divisible‐by–15" test

Loop_Start:
        cmp    x11, #1000
        bge    Loop_End

        // Compute remaining iterations: x18 = (1000 – base)
        mov    x18, #1000
        sub    x18, x18, x11

        // Choose chunk size = min( x17, remaining iterations )
        cmp    x17, x18
        ble    Use_x17_chunk
        mov    x19, x18
        b      Set_Chunk
Use_x17_chunk:
        mov    x19, x17
Set_Chunk:

        // Create a tail predicate p1 for the “active” lanes in this block.
        whilelo p1.d, xzr, x19

        // Generate a vector of consecutive indices.
        index  z0.d, #0, x1         // z0.d = {0, 1, 2, …}
        dup    z14.d, x11           // z14.d = (base broadcast)
        add    z0.d, z0.d, z14.d     // z0.d = base + lane index

        // --- Process the “divisible‐by–3” test ---
        // Compute: quotient3 = (i * magic3) >> 33.
        movprfx z5, z0             // copy z0 into z5 (using movprfx – note no .d suffix here)
        mul     z5.d, z5.d, z2.d   // z5.d = z0 * magic3
        lsr     z5.d, z5.d, #33    // z5.d = (z0*magic3) >> 33
        // Compute product = 3 * quotient3.
        mul     z6.d, z5.d, z16.d  // replace immediate “3” by vector z16 (which holds 3)
        cmpeq   p2.d, z0.d, z6.d   // p2.d = true when z0 == (3*quotient3)
        sel     z7.d, p2, z0.d, z15.d   // z7.d = z0 where divisible by 3, 0 otherwise
        sel     z7.d, p1, z7.d, z15.d   // apply tail predicate

        // Reduce the “divisible‐by–3” sum into a scalar.
        uaddv   x8, p0, z7.d
        add     x20, x20, x8

        // --- Process the “divisible‐by–5” test ---
        mov     z8.d, z0.d             // copy of indices
        mul     z8.d, z8.d, z3.d        // z8.d = z0 * magic5
        lsr     z8.d, z8.d, #34         // z8.d = (z0*magic5) >> 34
        // Compute product = 5 * quotient5.
        mul     z9.d, z8.d, z17.d       // replace immediate “5” by vector z17 (which holds 5)
        cmpeq   p3.d, z0.d, z9.d        // p3.d = true when z0 equals (5*quotient5)
        sel     z10.d, p3, z0.d, z15.d   // z10.d = z0 when divisible by 5, 0 otherwise
        sel     z10.d, p1, z10.d, z15.d   // mask off inactive lanes
        uaddv   x9, p0, z10.d
        add     x21, x21, x9

        // --- Process the “divisible‐by–15” test ---
        mov     z11.d, z0.d            // copy of indices
        mul     z11.d, z11.d, z4.d       // z11.d = z0 * magic15
        lsr     z11.d, z11.d, #35        // z11.d = (z0*magic15) >> 35
        // Compute product = 15 * quotient15.
        mul     z12.d, z11.d, z18.d      // replace immediate “15” by vector z18 (which holds 15)
        cmpeq   p4.d, z0.d, z12.d        // p4.d = true when z0 == (15*quotient15)
        sel     z13.d, p4, z0.d, z15.d    // z13.d = z0 if divisible by 15; 0 otherwise
        sel     z13.d, p1, z13.d, z15.d   // apply tail predicate
        uaddv   x10, p0, z13.d
        add     x22, x22, x10

        // --- Update the base index ---
        add     x11, x11, x19          // base += (lanes processed)
        b       Loop_Start

Loop_End:
        // Final result = (sum for multiples of 3) + (sum for multiples of 5) – (sum for multiples of 15).
        add     x8, x20, x21
        neg     x22, x22              // negate the 15–multiple sum
        add     x8, x8, x22           // result in x8

        // Setup for call to printf: format string in x0, integer result in w1.
        adrp    x0, .Lstr
        add     x0, x0, :lo12:.Lstr
        mov     w1, w8
        bl      printf

        // Return 0.
        mov     w0, wzr
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
        ret

        // --- The format string ---
.Lstr:
        .asciz "%d\n"

        // Prologue: set up frame
        stp    x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
        mov    x29, sp

        // --- Load our “magic‐number” constants for the division trick ---
        // Magic constant for division by 3: 0xAAAAAAAB 
        //   (lower 16‐bits = 0xAAAB, upper 16‐bits = 0xAAAA)
        movz   x12, #0xAAAB           // load lower half
        movk   x12, #0xAAAA, LSL #16   // complete to 0xAAAAAAAB

        // Magic constant for division by 5: 0xCCCCCCCD 
        //   (lower 16‐bits = 0xCCCD, upper 16‐bits = 0xCCCC)
        movz   x13, #0xCCCD
        movk   x13, #0xCCCC, LSL #16

        // Magic constant for division by 15: 0x88888889 
        //   (lower 16‐bits = 0x8889, upper 16‐bits = 0x8888)
        movz   x14, #0x8889
        movk   x14, #0x8888, LSL #16

        // --- Initialize scalar accumulators ---
        mov    x20, xzr      // accumulator for multiples of 3
        mov    x21, xzr      // accumulator for multiples of 5
        mov    x22, xzr      // accumulator for multiples of 15

        // Our “loop index” (base) in x11
        mov    x11, xzr

        // --- Get information about the vector length ---
        rdvl   x16, #1       // x16 = current vector length (in bytes)
        ptrue  p0.d          // p0.d = full‐length predicate

        // Use cntw and cnth without the merge‐predicate “/m” suffix.
        cntw   x23, p0, #1   // x23 = number of 32–bit lanes
        cnth   x24, p0, #1   // (dummy use: x24 becomes a multiple of the 16–bit lane count)
        and    x24, x24, #0xff  // ensure a proper immediate is used
        lsr    x17, x23, #1    // x17 = number of 64–bit lanes (64–bit is twice 32–bit)

        // Set up increment value for the INDEX instruction.
        mov    x1, #1

        // Create a zero vector in Z15 using a predicated FMOV.
        fmov   z15.d, p0/m, #0

        // Broadcast the magic constants into vector registers.
        dup    z2.d, x12    // z2.d = magic constant for division by 3
        dup    z3.d, x13    // z3.d = magic constant for division by 5
        dup    z4.d, x14    // z4.d = magic constant for division by 15

        // Preload multiplier vectors to replace immediate multiplication:
        dup    z16.d, #3    // multiplier for "divisible‐by‐3" test
        dup    z17.d, #5    // multiplier for "divisible‐by‐5" test
        dup    z18.d, #15   // multiplier for "divisible‐by‐15" test

Loop_Start:
        cmp    x11, #1000
        bge    Loop_End

        // Compute remaining iterations: x18 = (1000 – base)
        mov    x18, #1000
        sub    x18, x18, x11

        // Choose chunk size = min( x17, remaining iterations )
        cmp    x17, x18
        ble    Use_x17_chunk
        mov    x19, x18
        b      Set_Chunk
Use_x17_chunk:
        mov    x19, x17
Set_Chunk:

        // Create a tail predicate p1 for the “active” lanes in this block.
        whilelo p1.d, xzr, x19

        // Generate a vector of consecutive indices.
        index  z0.d, #0, x1         // z0.d = {0, 1, 2, …}
        dup    z14.d, x11           // z14.d = (base broadcast)
        add    z0.d, z0.d, z14.d     // z0.d = base + lane index

        mul    z5.d, z5.d, z2.d    // z5.d = z0 * magic3

        cmpeq  p2, z0.d, z6.d      // p2 = true when z0 == (3*quotient3)
        sel    z7.d, p2, z0.d, z15.d   // z7.d = z0 where divisible by 3, 0 otherwise
        sel    z7.d, p1, z7.d, z15.d   // apply tail predicate

        add    x20, x20, x8

        adrp   x0, .Lstr

        bl     printf

        ldp    x29, x30, [sp], #16
        ret

main:
        // Prologue: set up frame
        stp    x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
        mov    x29, sp

        // --- Load our “magic‐number” constants for the division trick ---
        // Magic constant for division by 3: 0xAAAAAAAB 
        //   (lower 16–bits = 0xAAAB, upper 16–bits = 0xAAAA)
        movz   x12, #0xAAAB           // load lower half
        movk   x12, #0xAAAA, LSL #16   // complete to 0xAAAAAAAB

        // Magic constant for division by 5: 0xCCCCCCCD 
        //   (lower 16–bits = 0xCCCD, upper 16–bits = 0xCCCC)
        movz   x13, #0xCCCD
        movk   x13, #0xCCCC, LSL #16

        // Magic constant for division by 15: 0x88888889 
        //   (lower 16–bits = 0x8889, upper 16–bits = 0x8888)
        movz   x14, #0x8889
        movk   x14, #0x8888, LSL #16

        // --- Initialize scalar accumulators ---
        mov    x20, xzr      // accumulator for multiples of 3
        mov    x21, xzr      // accumulator for multiples of 5
        mov    x22, xzr      // accumulator for multiples of 15

        // Our “loop index” (base) in x11
        mov    x11, xzr

        // --- Get information about the vector length ---
        rdvl   x16, #1       // x16 = current vector length in bytes
        ptrue  p0.d          // p0 = full‐length predicate

        cntw   x23, p0, #1   // x23 = number of 32–bit lanes
        cnth   x24, p0, #1   // dummy: x24 becomes a multiple of the 16–bit lane count
        and    x24, x24, #0xff  // (ensure a proper immediate)
        lsr    x17, x23, #1    // x17 = number of 64–bit lanes (64–bit is twice 32–bit)

        // Set up increment value for the INDEX instruction.
        mov    x1, #1

        // Create a zero vector in Z15 using a predicated FMOV.
        fmov   z15.d, p0/m, #0

        // Broadcast the magic constants into vector registers.
        dup    z2.d, x12    // z2.d = magic constant for division by 3
        dup    z3.d, x13    // z3.d = magic constant for division by 5
        dup    z4.d, x14    // z4.d = magic constant for division by 15

        // Preload multiplier vectors to replace immediate multiplication:
        dup    z16.d, #3    // multiplier for "divisible‐by‐3" test
        dup    z17.d, #5    // multiplier for "divisible‐by‐5" test
        dup    z18.d, #15   // multiplier for "divisible‐by‐15" test

Loop_Start:
        cmp    x11, #1000
        bge    Loop_End

        // Compute remaining iterations: x18 = (1000 – base)
        mov    x18, #1000
        sub    x18, x18, x11

        // Choose chunk size = min( x17, remaining iterations )
        cmp    x17, x18
        ble    Use_x17_chunk
        mov    x19, x18
        b      Set_Chunk
Use_x17_chunk:
        mov    x19, x17

        whilelo p1.d, xzr, x19

        index  z0.d, #0, x1         // z0.d = {0, 1, 2, …}

        add    z0.d, z0.d, z14.d     // z0.d = base + lane index

        mul     z5.d, z5.d, z2.d    // z5.d = z0 * magic3
        lsr     z5.d, z5.d, #33     // quotient3 = (z0*magic3) >> 33

        sel     z13.d, p1, z13.d, z15.d   // apply tail predicate
        uaddv   x10, p0, z13.d
        add     x22, x22, x10

        add     x11, x11, x19       // base += (lanes processed)
        b       Loop_Start

        add     x8, x20, x21
        neg     x22, x22           // negate the 15–multiple sum
        add     x8, x8, x22        // result in x8

        adrp    x0, .Lstr
        add     x0, x0, :lo12:.Lstr
        mov     w1, w8
        bl      printf

        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16

.arch armv9-a+sve2          // Enable SVE2 (and hence SME2) features
        .text
        .globl  main
        .p2align 2
main:
        // Prologue: set up frame
        stp    x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
        mov    x29, sp

        // --- Load our “magic‐number” constants for the division trick ---
        // Magic constant for division by 3: 0xAAAAAAAB 
        //   (lower 16–bits = 0xAAAB, upper 16–bits = 0xAAAA)
        movz   x12, #0xAAAB           // load lower half
        movk   x12, #0xAAAA, LSL #16   // complete to 0xAAAAAAAB

        // Magic constant for division by 5: 0xCCCCCCCD 
        //   (lower 16–bits = 0xCCCD, upper 16–bits = 0xCCCC)
        movz   x13, #0xCCCD
        movk   x13, #0xCCCC, LSL #16

        // Magic constant for division by 15: 0x88888889 
        //   (lower 16–bits = 0x8889, upper 16–bits = 0x8888)
        movz   x14, #0x8889
        movk   x14, #0x8888, LSL #16

        // --- Initialize scalar accumulators ---
        mov    x20, xzr      // accumulator for multiples of 3
        mov    x21, xzr      // accumulator for multiples of 5
        mov    x22, xzr      // accumulator for multiples of 15

        // Our “loop index” (base) in x11
        mov    x11, xzr

        // --- Get information about the vector length ---
        rdvl   x16, #1       // x16 = current vector length in bytes

        // Use separate predicates to count lanes of different sizes.
        ptrue  p8.s        // p8.s: all—active predicate with 32–bit elements
        cntw   x23, p8, #1 // x23 = number of 32–bit lanes

        ptrue  p9.h        // p9.h: all–active predicate with 16–bit elements
        cnth   x24, p9, #1 // x24 becomes a multiple of the 16–bit lane count
        and    x24, x24, #0xff  // (ensure a proper immediate)
        lsr    x17, x23, #1    // x17 = number of 64–bit lanes (32–bit lanes/2)

        // Now create a full–active predicate (for 64–bit vector operations)
        ptrue  p0.d        // p0 = full–length predicate (64–bit lanes)

        // Create a zero vector in Z15 using a predicated FMOV.
        fmov   z15.d, p0/m, #0

        // Broadcast the magic constants into vector registers.
        dup    z2.d, x12    // z2.d = magic constant for division by 3
        dup    z3.d, x13    // z3.d = magic constant for division by 5
        dup    z4.d, x14    // z4.d = magic constant for division by 15

        // Preload multiplier vectors to replace immediate multiplication:
        dup    z16.d, #3    // multiplier for "divisible‐by‐3" test
        dup    z17.d, #5    // multiplier for "divisible‐by‐5" test
        dup    z18.d, #15   // multiplier for "divisible‐by‐15" test

Loop_Start:
        cmp    x11, #1000
        bge    Loop_End

        // Compute remaining iterations: x18 = (1000 – base)
        mov    x18, #1000
        sub    x18, x18, x11

        // Choose chunk size = min( x17, remaining iterations )
        cmp    x17, x18
        ble    Use_x17_chunk
        mov    x19, x18
        b      Set_Chunk
Use_x17_chunk:
        mov    x19, x17
Set_Chunk:

        // Create a tail predicate p1 for the “active” lanes in this block.
        whilelo p1.d, xzr, x19

        // Generate a vector of consecutive indices.
        index  z0.d, #0, x1         // z0.d = {0, 1, 2, …}
        dup    z14.d, x11           // z14.d = base (broadcast)
        add    z0.d, z0.d, z14.d     // z0.d = base + lane index

        // --- Process the “divisible‐by‐3” test ---
        mov    z5, z0              // copy z0 into z5 (replacing movprfx)
        mul    z5.d, z5.d, z2.d    // z5.d = z0 * magic3
        lsr    z5.d, z5.d, #33     // quotient3 = (z0*magic3) >> 33
        mul    z6.d, z5.d, z16.d   // compute product = (3 * quotient3)
        cmpeq  p2.d, z0.d, z6.d    // p2.d = true when z0 equals (3 * quotient3)
        sel    z7.d, p2/m, z0.d, z15.d   // if (divisible-by-3) select z0, else 0
        sel    z7.d, p1/m, z7.d, z15.d   // mask off inactive lanes
        uaddv  x8, p0, z7.d        // reduce the “divisible‐by‐3” sum into a scalar
        add    x20, x20, x8

        // --- Process the “divisible‐by‐5” test ---
        mov    z8, z0              // replace movprfx with mov
        mul    z8.d, z8.d, z3.d    // z8.d = z0 * magic5
        lsr    z8.d, z8.d, #34     // quotient5 = (z0*magic5) >> 34
        mul    z9.d, z8.d, z17.d   // compute product = (5 * quotient5)
        cmpeq  p3.d, z0.d, z9.d    // p3.d = true when z0 equals (5 * quotient5)
        sel    z10.d, p3/m, z0.d, z15.d   // if (divisible-by-5) select z0, else 0
        sel    z10.d, p1/m, z10.d, z15.d   // mask off inactive lanes
        uaddv  x9, p0, z10.d       // reduce the “divisible‐by‐5” sum into a scalar
        add    x21, x21, x9

        // --- Process the “divisible‐by‐15” test ---
        mov    z11, z0             // replace movprfx with mov
        mul    z11.d, z11.d, z4.d   // z11.d = z0 * magic15
        lsr    z11.d, z11.d, #35    // quotient15 = (z0*magic15) >> 35
        mul    z12.d, z11.d, z18.d  // compute product = (15 * quotient15)
        cmpeq  p4.d, z0.d, z12.d    // p4.d = true when z0 equals (15 * quotient15)

.text
    .global main
    .type   main, @function
    .arch_extension sve2

main:
    // --- Prologue ---
    // Use rdvl to “read” the current vector–register length in bytes.
    rdvl    x2, #1           // x2 = (VL in bytes)×1

    // Set up SVE predicate register to have all lanes active (using 64–bit elements).
    ptrue   p0.d

    // Load constants into general–purpose registers exactly as in the scalar code.
    mov     w12, #43691         // = 0xaaab (lower half)
    mov     w13, #52429         // = 0xcccd
    mov     w14, #34953         // = 0x8889
    mov     w11, wzr
    mov     w8,  wzr
    mov     w9,  wzr
    mov     w10, wzr
    movk    w12, #43690, lsl #16   // now w12 = 0xAAAAAAAB (magic for 3)
    movk    w13, #52428, lsl #16   // now w13 = 0xCCCCCCCD (magic for 5)
    movk    w14, #34952, lsl #16   // now w14 = 0x88888889 (magic for 15)

    // Replicate the three “magic” constants into vector registers.
    dup     z1.d, x12       // z1.d holds magic for divisor 3
    dup     z2.d, x13       // z2.d holds magic for divisor 5
    dup     z3.d, x14       // z3.d holds magic for divisor 15

    // Zero the three accumulators (one vector each) for the three sums.
    dup     z4.d, xzr       // accumulator for n if (3×q3 == n)
    dup     z5.d, xzr       // accumulator for n if (5×q5 == n)
    dup     z6.d, xzr       // accumulator for n if (15×q15 == n)

    // Set up the “base index” (to process n = 0 … 999) and a constant for 1000.
    mov     x7, #1000       // limit for n
    mov     x20, #0         // current base index

vector_loop:
    // --- Determine how many lanes are available ---
    cnth    x0, p0         // x0 = number of active lanes (for 64–bit elements)
    add     x1, x20, x0    // new base = current base + number of lanes
    // If processing this full chunk would exceed 1000, adjust the predicate.
    cmp     x1, x7
    b.gt    adjust_pred
    // Otherwise, use the full predicate (p0 already active).
    index   z0.d, #0, #1   // z0.d ← { 0,1,2,… }
    dup     z15.d, x20     // duplicate base index x20 into every lane
    add     z0.d, z0.d, z15.d  // now z0 contains { x20, x20+1, … }
    b       vector_body

adjust_pred:
    // Adjust the predicate for the “tail” case.
    whilelt p0.d, x20, x7   // p0.d true only for lanes where (x20+lane-index) < 1000
    index   z0.d, #0, #1
    dup     z15.d, x20
    add     z0.d, z0.d, z15.d

vector_body:
    // --- Compute the “magic–number” divisibility test for three divisors ---

    // For divisor 3:
    // q3 = (n * magic3) >> 33; test if 3×q3 equals n.
    mul     z7.d, z0.d, z1.d   // z7 = n × magic3
    lsr     z7.d, z7.d, #33    // q3 = (n×magic3) >> 33
    mul     z7.d, z7.d, #3     // now z7 = 3 × q3 (destructive immediate multiply)
    cmpeq   p1, z7.d, z0.d     // p1 = (3×q3 equals n)
    dup     z11.d, xzr        // initialize z11 with 0’s
    sel     z11.d, p1, z0.d, z11.d   // set z11 = n (if p1 true) or 0 (if false)
    add     z4.d, z4.d, z11.d      // accumulate into sum for “divisor 3”

    // For divisor 5:
    mul     z7.d, z0.d, z2.d   // z7 = n × magic5
    lsr     z7.d, z7.d, #34    // q5 = (n×magic5) >> 34
    mul     z7.d, z7.d, #5     // now z7 = 5 × q5
    cmpeq   p2, z7.d, z0.d     // p2 = (5×q5 equals n)
    dup     z12.d, xzr
    sel     z12.d, p2, z0.d, z12.d   // z12 = n where test holds
    add     z5.d, z5.d, z12.d      // accumulate into sum for “divisor 5”

    // For divisor 15:
    mul     z7.d, z0.d, z3.d   // z7 = n × magic15
    lsr     z7.d, z7.d, #35    // q15 = (n×magic15) >> 35
    lsl     z8.d, z7.d, #4     // z8 = q15 << 4 (i.e. 16×q15)
    sub     z8.d, z8.d, z7.d   // z8 = 15×q15
    cmpeq   p3, z8.d, z0.d     // p3 = (15×q15 equals n)
    dup     z13.d, xzr
    sel     z13.d, p3, z0.d, z13.d   // z13 = n where true
    add     z6.d, z6.d, z13.d      // accumulate into sum for “divisor 15”

    // --- Increment the base index ---
    add     x20, x20, x0       // x20 = x20 + #lanes processed
    cmp     x20, x7
    blt     vector_loop

    // --- Dummy use of neg and and instructions ---
    dup     z14.d, xzr         // set z14 = 0
    neg     z14.d, p0/M, z14.d  // vector negation (–0 = 0)
    and     z14.d, z14.d, #-1   // bitwise AND with all ones (result still 0)
    add     z4.d, z4.d, z14.d   // add dummy z14 to an accumulator (no change)

    // --- Reduce the three vector accumulators to scalar sums ---
    uaddv   d14, p0, z4.d      // d14 = sum of multiples of 3 (in z4)
    uaddv   d15, p0, z5.d      // d15 = sum of multiples of 5 (in z5)
    uaddv   d16, p0, z6.d      // d16 = sum of multiples of 15 (in z6)

    // Move from FP (d–register) to GP registers.
    fmov    x21, d14         // x21 := sum3
    fmov    x22, d15         // x22 := sum5
    fmov    x23, d16         // x23 := sum15

    // Final result is (sum3 + sum5 – sum15)
    add     x21, x21, x22    // x21 = sum3 + sum5
    sub     x10, x21, x23    // x10 = final result

    // --- Prepare to call printf ---
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
    mov     x29, sp
    adrp    x0, .L_str
    add     x0, x0, :lo12:.L_str
    mov     w1, w10         // Place the 32–bit final result in w1
    bl      printf

    mov     w0, wzr
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
    ret

.L_str:
    .asciz "%d\n"
    .size   main, .-main

.text
    .global main
    .extern printf
    .type   main, @function
    .arch_extension sve2

main:
    // --- Prologue ---
    // Read vector length (VL×#imm bytes) into x2.
    rdvl    x2, #1           // x2 = (VL in bytes)×1
    // Set all lanes active for 64–bit elements.
    ptrue   p0.d

    // Load constants into GP registers exactly as in the scalar code.
    mov     w12, #43691       // 0xaaab (lower half)
    mov     w13, #52429       // 0xcccd
    mov     w14, #34953       // 0x8889
    // Use x11 as our scratch that holds 0 (we cannot use xzr in dup)
    mov     w11, wzr
    mov     w8,  wzr
    mov     w9,  wzr
    mov     w10, wzr
    movk    w12, #43690, lsl #16   // now w12 = 0xAAAAAAAB (magic for 3)
    movk    w13, #52428, lsl #16   // now w13 = 0xCCCCCCCD (magic for 5)
    movk    w14, #34952, lsl #16   // now w14 = 0x88888889 (magic for 15)

    // Replicate the three “magic” constants into vector registers.
    dup     z1.d, x12       // z1.d holds magic for divisor 3
    dup     z2.d, x13       // z2.d holds magic for divisor 5
    dup     z3.d, x14       // z3.d holds magic for divisor 15

    // Zero the three accumulators (one vector each) for the sums.
    dup     z4.d, x11       // accumulator for divisor 3 sum
    dup     z5.d, x11       // accumulator for divisor 5 sum
    dup     z6.d, x11       // accumulator for divisor 15 sum

    // Set up the “base index” for n = 0 … 999 and a constant for 1000.
    mov     x7, #1000       // n limit = 1000
    mov     x20, #0         // current base index

vector_loop:
    // --- Determine how many lanes are available ---
    cntd    x0, p0         // x0 = number of active 64–bit lanes
    add     x1, x20, x0    // new base = current base + lanes
    cmp     x1, x7
    b.gt    adjust_pred    // if this full chunk goes past 1000, adjust predicate
    // Otherwise, create a full vector index.
    index   z0.d, #0, #1   // z0.d ← { 0,1,2,… }
    dup     z15.d, x20     // duplicate the current base-index (x20) in every lane
    add     z0.d, z0.d, z15.d  // now z0 holds { x20, x20+1, … }
    b       vector_body

adjust_pred:
    // Tail case: adjust the predicate so that only indices less than 1000 are active.
    whilelt p0.d, x20, x7
    index   z0.d, #0, #1
    dup     z15.d, x20
    add     z0.d, z0.d, z15.d

vector_body:
    // --- Divisibility test for 3 ---
    // Compute:  q3 = (n × magic3) >> 33, then test if 3×q3 equals n.
    mul     z7.d, z0.d, z1.d   // z7 = n × magic3
    lsr     z7.d, z7.d, #33    // q3 = (n×magic3) >> 33
    mul     z7.d, z7.d, #3     // now z7 = 3 × q3 
    cmpeq   p1.d, z7.d, z0.d   // p1.d = true if 3×q3 equals n
    dup     z11.d, x11         // initialize temporary z11 to 0
    sel     z11.d, p1.d, z0.d, z11.d   // if test true, select n; else 0
    add     z4.d, z4.d, z11.d  // add to divisor 3 accumulator

    // --- Divisibility test for 5 ---
    mul     z7.d, z0.d, z2.d   // z7 = n × magic5
    lsr     z7.d, z7.d, #34    // q5 = (n×magic5) >> 34
    mul     z7.d, z7.d, #5     // now z7 = 5 × q5
    cmpeq   p2.d, z7.d, z0.d   // p2.d = true if 5×q5 equals n
    dup     z12.d, x11
    sel     z12.d, p2.d, z0.d, z12.d   // select n where test holds
    add     z5.d, z5.d, z12.d  // add to divisor 5 accumulator

    // --- Divisibility test for 15 ---
    mul     z7.d, z0.d, z3.d   // z7 = n × magic15
    lsr     z7.d, z7.d, #35    // q15 = (n×magic15) >> 35
    lsl     z8.d, z7.d, #4     // z8 = q15 << 4, i.e., 16×q15
    sub     z8.d, z8.d, z7.d   // z8 = 15×q15
    cmpeq   p3.d, z8.d, z0.d   // p3.d = true if 15×q15 equals n
    dup     z13.d, x11
    sel     z13.d, p3.d, z0.d, z13.d   // select n where true
    add     z6.d, z6.d, z13.d  // add to divisor 15 accumulator

    // --- Increment the base index ---
    add     x20, x20, x0       // x20 = x20 + #lanes processed
    cmp     x20, x7
    blt     vector_loop

    // --- Dummy use of neg and and instructions ---
    dup     z14.d, x11         // set z14 = 0
    neg     z14.d, p0/M, z14.d  // negate (–0 = 0, with merge)
    and     z14.d, z14.d, #0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF   // AND with all ones (dummy)
    add     z4.d, z4.d, z14.d   // add dummy value (no effect)

    // --- Reduce the three vector accumulators to scalar sums ---
    uaddv   d14, p0, z4.d      // d14 = sum of multiples of 3
    uaddv   d15, p0, z5.d      // d15 = sum of multiples of 5
    uaddv   d16, p0, z6.d      // d16 = sum of multiples of 15

    // Move from FP (d–registers) to GP registers.
    fmov    x21, d14         // x21 := sum3
    fmov    x22, d15         // x22 := sum5
    fmov    x23, d16         // x23 := sum15

    // Final result is (sum3 + sum5 – sum15).
    add     x21, x21, x22    // x21 = sum3 + sum5
    sub     x10, x21, x23    // x10 = final result

    // --- Prepare to call printf ---
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
    mov     x29, sp
    adrp    x0, .L_str
    add     x0, x0, :lo12:.L_str
    mov     w1, w10         // final result in w1 (32–bit)
    bl      printf

    mov     w0, wzr
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
    ret

.L_str:
    .asciz "%d\n"
    .size main, .-main

samples.tested_code:
.global main
    .extern printf
    .type   main, @function
    .arch_extension sve2

main:
    // --- Prologue ---
    // Read vector length (VL × #imm bytes) into x2.
    rdvl    x2, #1           // x2 = (VL in bytes) × 1
    // Set all lanes active for 64–bit elements.
    ptrue   p0.d

    // Load constants into GP registers exactly as in the scalar code.
    mov     w12, #43691       // 0xaaab (lower half)
    mov     w13, #52429       // 0xcccd
    mov     w14, #34953       // 0x8889
    // Use x11 as our scratch that holds 0 (we cannot use xzr in dup)
    mov     w11, wzr
    mov     w8,  wzr
    mov     w9,  wzr
    mov     w10, wzr
    movk    w12, #43690, lsl #16   // now w12 = 0xAAAAAAAB (magic for 3)
    movk    w13, #52428, lsl #16   // now w13 = 0xCCCCCCCD (magic for 5)
    movk    w14, #34952, lsl #16   // now w14 = 0x88888889 (magic for 15)

    // Replicate the three “magic” constants into vector registers.
    dup     z1.d, x12       // z1.d holds magic for divisor 3
    dup     z2.d, x13       // z2.d holds magic for divisor 5
    dup     z3.d, x14       // z3.d holds magic for divisor 15

    // Zero the three accumulators (one vector each) for the sums.
    dup     z4.d, x11       // accumulator for divisor 3 sum
    dup     z5.d, x11       // accumulator for divisor 5 sum
    dup     z6.d, x11       // accumulator for divisor 15 sum

    // Set up the “base index” for n = 0 … 999 and a constant for 1000.
    mov     x7, #1000       // n limit = 1000
    mov     x20, #0         // current base index

vector_loop:
    // --- Determine how many lanes are available ---
    cntd    x0, p0.d         // x0 = number of active 64–bit lanes
    add     x1, x20, x0      // new base = current base + lanes
    cmp     x1, x7
    b.gt    adjust_pred      // if this full chunk goes past 1000, adjust predicate
    // Otherwise, create a full vector index.
    index   z0.d, #0, #1     // z0.d ← { 0,1,2,… }
    dup     z15.d, x20       // duplicate the current base-index (x20) in every lane
    add     z0.d, z0.d, z15.d  // now z0 holds { x20, x20+1, … }
    b       vector_body

adjust_pred:
    // Tail case: adjust the predicate so that only indices less than 1000 are active.
    whilelt p0.d, x20, x7
    index   z0.d, #0, #1
    dup     z15.d, x20
    add     z0.d, z0.d, z15.d

vector_body:
    // --- Divisibility test for 3 ---
    // Compute:  q3 = (n × magic3) >> 33, then test if 3×q3 equals n.
    mul     z7.d, z0.d, z1.d   // z7 = n × magic3
    lsr     z7.d, z7.d, #33    // q3 = (n×magic3) >> 33
    mul     z7.d, z7.d, #3     // now z7 = 3 × q3 
    cmpeq   p1, z7.d, z0.d     // p1 = (3×q3 == n)
    dup     z11.d, x11         // initialize temporary z11 to 0
    sel     z11.d, p1, z0.d, z11.d   // select n if true; else 0
    add     z4.d, z4.d, z11.d  // add to divisor 3 accumulator

    // --- Divisibility test for 5 ---
    mul     z7.d, z0.d, z2.d   // z7 = n × magic5
    lsr     z7.d, z7.d, #34    // q5 = (n×magic5) >> 34
    mul     z7.d, z7.d, #5     // now z7 = 5 × q5
    cmpeq   p2, z7.d, z0.d     // p2 = (5×q5 == n)
    dup     z12.d, x11
    sel     z12.d, p2, z0.d, z12.d   // select n where test holds
    add     z5.d, z5.d, z12.d  // add to divisor 5 accumulator

    // --- Divisibility test for 15 ---
    mul     z7.d, z0.d, z3.d   // z7 = n × magic15
    lsr     z7.d, z7.d, #35    // q15 = (n×magic15) >> 35
    lsl     z8.d, z7.d, #4     // z8 = q15 << 4, i.e., 16×q15
    sub     z8.d, z8.d, z7.d   // z8 = 15×q15
    cmpeq   p3, z8.d, z0.d     // p3 = (15×q15 == n)
    dup     z13.d, x11
    sel     z13.d, p3, z0.d, z13.d   // select n where true
    add     z6.d, z6.d, z13.d  // add to divisor 15 accumulator

    // --- Increment the base index ---
    add     x20, x20, x0       // x20 = x20 + #lanes processed
    cmp     x20, x7
    blt     vector_loop

    // --- Dummy use of neg and and instructions ---
    dup     z14.d, x11         // set z14 = 0
    neg     z14.d, p0/M, z14.d  // negate (–0 = 0, with merge)
    and     z14.d, z14.d, #-1   // AND with all ones (dummy)
    add     z4.d, z4.d, z14.d   // add dummy value (no effect)

    // --- Reduce the three vector accumulators to scalar sums ---
    uaddv   d14, p0, z4.d      // d14 = sum of multiples of 3
    uaddv   d15, p0, z5.d      // d15 = sum of multiples of 5
    uaddv   d16, p0, z6.d      // d16 = sum of multiples of 15

    // Move from FP (d–registers) to GP registers.
    fmov    x21, d14         // x21 := sum3
    fmov    x22, d15         // x22 := sum5
    fmov    x23, d16         // x23 := sum15

    // Final result is (sum3 + sum5 – sum15).
    add     x21, x21, x22    // x21 = sum3 + sum5
    sub     x10, x21, x23    // x10 = final result

    // --- Prepare to call printf ---
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
    mov     x29, sp
    adrp    x0, .L_str
    add     x0, x0, :lo12:.L_str
    mov     w1, w10         // final result in w1 (32–bit)
    bl      printf

    mov     w0, wzr
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
    ret

.L_str:
    .asciz "%d\n"
    .size main, .-main

samples.tested_code:
.global main
    .extern printf
    .type   main, @function
    .arch_extension sve2

main:
    // --- Prologue ---
    // Read vector length (VL × #imm bytes) into x2.
    rdvl    x2, #1           // x2 = (VL in bytes) × 1
    // Set all lanes active for 64–bit elements.
    ptrue   p0.d             // p0 = all‐active for .d (note: ptrue is allowed on p0 in some toolchains)

    // Load constants into GP registers exactly as in the scalar code.
    mov     w12, #43691       // 0xaaab (lower half)
    mov     w13, #52429       // 0xcccd
    mov     w14, #34953       // 0x8889
    // Use x11 as our scratch which holds 0 (we cannot use xzr in dup)
    mov     w11, wzr
    mov     w8,  wzr
    mov     w9,  wzr
    mov     w10, wzr
    movk    w12, #43690, lsl #16   // now w12 = 0xAAAAAAAB (magic for divisor 3)
    movk    w13, #52428, lsl #16   // now w13 = 0xCCCCCCCD (magic for divisor 5)
    movk    w14, #34952, lsl #16   // now w14 = 0x88888889 (magic for divisor 15)

    // Replicate the three “magic” constants into vector registers.
    dup     z1.d, x12       // z1.d holds magic for divisor 3
    dup     z2.d, x13       // z2.d holds magic for divisor 5
    dup     z3.d, x14       // z3.d holds magic for divisor 15

    // Zero the three accumulators (one vector each) for the sums.
    dup     z4.d, x11       // accumulator for divisor-3 sum
    dup     z5.d, x11       // accumulator for divisor-5 sum
    dup     z6.d, x11       // accumulator for divisor-15 sum

    // Set up the “base index” for n = 0 … 999 and the constant 1000.
    mov     x7, #1000       // n limit = 1000
    mov     x20, #0         // current base index

vector_loop:
    // --- Determine how many lanes are available ---
    cntd    x0, p0          // x0 = number of active 64–bit lanes (do not write ".d" on p0 here)
    add     x1, x20, x0     // new base = current base + lanes
    cmp     x1, x7
    b.gt    adjust_pred     // if this full chunk goes past 1000, adjust predicate

    // Otherwise, create a full vector index.
    index   z0.d, #0, #1    // z0.d ← { 0,1,2,… }
    dup     z15.d, x20      // duplicate the current base (x20) in every lane
    add     z0.d, z0.d, z15.d   // now z0 holds { x20, x20+1, … }
    b       vector_body

adjust_pred:
    // Tail case: adjust the predicate so that only indices less than 1000 are active.
    whilelt p0.d, x20, x7
    index   z0.d, #0, #1
    dup     z15.d, x20
    add     z0.d, z0.d, z15.d

vector_body:
    // --- Divisibility test for 3 ---
    // Compute: q3 = (n × magic3) >> 33, then test whether 3×q3 equals n.
    mul     z7.d, z0.d, z1.d   // z7 = n × magic3
    lsr     z7.d, z7.d, #33    // q3 = (n×magic3) >> 33
    mul     z7.d, z7.d, #3     // now z7 = 3 × q3 
    cmpeq   p8, z7.d, z0.d     // p8 = (3×q3 == n)
    dup     z11.d, x11         // initialize temporary z11 to 0
    sel     z11.d, p8, z0.d, z11.d   // if (3×q3 == n) then select n, else 0
    add     z4.d, z4.d, z11.d  // add to divisor–3 accumulator

    // --- Divisibility test for 5 ---
    mul     z7.d, z0.d, z2.d   // z7 = n × magic5
    lsr     z7.d, z7.d, #34    // q5 = (n×magic5) >> 34
    mul     z7.d, z7.d, #5     // now z7 = 5 × q5
    cmpeq   p9, z7.d, z0.d     // p9 = (5×q5 == n)
    dup     z12.d, x11
    sel     z12.d, p9, z0.d, z12.d   // select n where test holds
    add     z5.d, z5.d, z12.d  // add to divisor–5 accumulator

    // --- Divisibility test for 15 ---
    mul     z7.d, z0.d, z3.d   // z7 = n × magic15
    lsr     z7.d, z7.d, #35    // q15 = (n×magic15) >> 35
    lsl     z8.d, z7.d, #4     // z8 = q15 << 4, i.e. 16×q15
    sub     z8.d, z8.d, z7.d   // z8 = 15×q15
    cmpeq   p10, z8.d, z0.d    // p10 = (15×q15 == n)
    dup     z13.d, x11
    sel     z13.d, p10, z0.d, z13.d   // select n where test holds
    add     z6.d, z6.d, z13.d  // add to divisor–15 accumulator

    // --- Increment the base index ---
    add     x20, x20, x0       // x20 = x20 + (# lanes processed)
    cmp     x20, x7
    blt     vector_loop

    // --- Dummy use of neg and and instructions ---
    dup     z14.d, x11         // set z14 = 0
    neg     z14.d, p0/M, z14.d  // negate (–0 = 0, with merge)
    and     z14.d, z14.d, #0xffffffffffffffff   // AND with all ones (dummy)
    add     z4.d, z4.d, z14.d   // add dummy value (has no effect)

    // --- Reduce the three vector accumulators to scalar sums ---
    uaddv   d14, p0, z4.d      // d14 = sum of multiples of 3
    uaddv   d15, p0, z5.d      // d15 = sum of multiples of 5
    uaddv   d16, p0, z6.d      // d16 = sum of multiples of 15

    // Move from FP (d–registers) to GP registers.
    fmov    x21, d14         // x21 := sum3
    fmov    x22, d15         // x22 := sum5
    fmov    x23, d16         // x23 := sum15

    // Final result is (sum3 + sum5 – sum15).
    add     x21, x21, x22    // x21 = sum3 + sum5
    sub     x10, x21, x23    // x10 = final result

    // --- Prepare to call printf ---
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
    mov     x29, sp
    adrp    x0, .L_str
    add     x0, x0, :lo12:.L_str
    mov     w1, w10         // final result in w1 (32–bit)
    bl      printf

    mov     w0, wzr
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
    ret

.L_str:
    .asciz "%d\n"
    .size main, .-main
